lines.text: I'm zonked, so I'm going to bed.

data.define: Used when you're so tired you could fall asleep.

example.text: I'm zonked, so I'm going to bed.

misuse.text: Don't say 'zonked' in a business email.

publish.title: What does "zonked" mean?
publish.value: Zonked = Completely worn out and sleepy. Example: "I'm zonked, so I'm going to bed." (casual English, US).
